To adapt, we should construct a CompletableFuture based on the replayed result (completing normally for non-exceptions and exceptionally for Throwable) and pass that CompletableFuture to both RpcContext and FutureContext. We will keep the existing AsyncRpcResult usage for the MockResult since that part compiles, and only adjust the future setting code.

We also need to add an import for java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.

These are minimal, localized changes that maintain functionality and satisfy the new API requirements.
